title: Integrate INT8 weight-only calibration pipeline (GPTQ/AWQ) and nightly convergence regression
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Add end-to-end integration of INT8 weight-only calibration profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) into the calibration pipeline and introduce dedicated nightly convergence/regression jobs. This ticket covers pipeline wiring, new CI jobs, scripted validation for accuracy & calibration drift, and monitoring/alerting for regressions vs FP16 baseline. Motivation: recent adoptions of weight-only INT8 quantization by customers require an automated safety net to detect accuracy regressions early and ensure calibration parameters produce stable outputs across model families.
tasks: Add GPTQ and AWQ profile ingestion step to the calibration orchestrator
Create calibration config spec allowing per-layer and per-block overrides for weight-only quant formats
Implement post-calibration evaluation harness that computes delta vs FP16 baseline (PPL, exact-match, BLEU where applicable)
Add nightly CI job matrix for representative models and sequence lengths
Persist calibration artifacts (profiles, per-layer stats) to object store with metadata tags
Create a regression dashboard in Console showing historic deltas and CI history
Write rollback playbook and automated fallback to non-quantized model variants on severe regression
acceptance_criteria: Nightly CI completes for at least 6 representative models (small/medium/large across two families) without infra failures
For each model, INT8 quantized outputs must not exceed a 2.5% relative degradation in main eval metric vs FP16 baseline across the canonical eval set
Calibration artifacts are stored and retrievable by run-id; per-layer histograms and scale factors available in Console
Regression alerts fire when 3 consecutive nightly runs show monotonic degradation >1% beyond noise threshold
Runbooks and rollback steps documented and reviewed by SRE and ML infra teams
test_matrix: Quant paths: GPTQ (4-bit per-block simulated for weight-only INT8 parity), AWQ (GPTQ-compatible variant), FP16 baseline
Datasets: curated-eval-1000 (mix of instruct/data/completion), translation-sample-200, codebench-500
Calibration modes: zero-shot (no calibration prompts), 32-shot profile, synthetic-statistics-driven calibration
ci_jobs: ci/quant/int8-nightly-fast (subset: 3 small models, short sequence lengths)
ci/quant/int8-nightly-full (all models, all sequence lengths) - runs on dedicated GPU pool
ci/quant/calibration-smoke (PR gate) - runs on each PR touching calibration code
ci/quant/profile-compare (regression detector) - uploads metrics to metrics-store and posts status
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Land ingestion + storage of calibration artifacts behind feature-flag. Run nightly-fast-only to validate infra (3 days)
Phase 2: Enable full-nightly matrix, build Console dashboard for deltas, solicit ML-IR review (1 week)
Phase 3: Turn on PR-gated smoke tests and require calibration-smoke for any quant-related PRs (2 days)
Phase 4: Promote artifact retention policy and link to release process; add automated fallback policies to routing layer (post-merge)
Canary policy: if nightly-full shows >3% degradation on high-usage model two days in a row, automatically mark latest profiles as ‘suspect’ and alert owners
monitoring_playbook: Alert: regression_percentile_95_delta > 1.5% for 3 successive runs -> Pager to ML-eng oncall
Alert: calibration_job_fail_rate > 5% in 24h -> SRE ticket and investigate infra (OOM, kernel mismatch)
Action: on suspected profile regression, compare per-layer scale histograms between failing and last-good run; if mismatch, run targeted per-layer re-calibration
Action: if rollback needed, update smart-routing table to prefer FP16 variant and notify customers via incident channel
risks: Risk: GPTQ/AWQ implementations diverge slightly across repo forks leading to different numerical outcomes - mitigation: pin version and add unit tests that assert bit-level determinism where possible
Risk: Nightly matrix increases GPU spend - mitigation: pay down by sampling smaller subset and running full matrix only on cadence (weekly) or after significant commits
Risk: False positives due to dataset noise - mitigation: use statistical smoothing, multiple seeds, and sanity thresholds before alerting
Risk: Calibration artifacts leaking sensitive prompts if saved naively - mitigation: redact prompt text and keep only derived stats/scalars in persisted artifacts
qa_plan: Run targeted hand-checks for top 10 customer-facing prompts pre/post quant on candidate profiles
Pair with ML research to run locally-compiled kernel comparisons for a random subset of runs
Create synthetic regression tests that intentionally perturb scale factors to validate alerting and rollback mechanics
Engage Solutions Engineering to run user-simulated traffic against canary models post-rollout
notes: Design decision: Use a single canonical artifact format (JSON + compressed numpy arrays) for portability between private deployments and hosted pipelines
Trade-off: Storing per-layer histograms increases storage but drastically reduces time-to-debug for regressions; retention set to 30 days by default
Performance expectation: quantized int8 inference should show at least 1.8x median speedup on T4-like hardware for large context lengths
Follow-up: consider adding FP8 profile compatibility in a follow-up ticket once INT8 stability is achieved
